meta.scope: Iraq Batch 7 — Poverty, education, health (life expectancy), and climate densification.

candidates.title: Poverty and living standards statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from World Bank-aligned and national monitoring sources
candidates.description: Poverty rates and living-standards indicators. Security and living conditions have improved relative to peak-conflict years; poverty reduction has been accompanied by gains in asset ownership and public-service access, though labour-force participation remains low, especially for women.

candidates.title: Education enrolment and completion statistics
candidates.description: Statistics and estimates on primary and secondary completion and enrolment. Primary completion has risen substantially; upper-secondary completion remains more limited. Kurdistan Region operates a distinct education administration.
candidates.notes: Core education access and human-capital node.

candidates.title: Life expectancy and health outcome statistics
candidates.description: Life expectancy at birth and related health indicators. Continuously referenced in human-development and post-conflict recovery analysis.

candidates.title: Greenhouse gas emissions statistics
candidates.description: National GHG emissions estimates. Energy and oil-related activities dominate the emissions profile; the series is referenced in climate and energy-transition discussions.
candidates.notes: Core climate-measurement node under oil dominance.

candidates.title: Iraq social–climate densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from welfare, education, health and climate sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding poverty and living standards, education enrolment/completion, life expectancy, and GHG emissions into a coherent social and climate residual layer.
